# Glintvex

> Glintvex is a senior software engineering company for SaaS and FinTech businesses. It designs, builds and scales the platforms revenue runs on: payments, ledgers, dashboards, APIs and cloud. Senior engineers only, with a kickoff within 14 days of agreeing scope. Clients in Australia, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates and the United States.

Website: https://glintvex.com/
Contact: info@glintvex.com (reply within one business day; NDA on request)

## Services

- **SaaS platforms**: multi-tenant web apps, admin dashboards and customer portals, from MVP to 100,000+ users. Next.js / React frontends; NestJS, Node and Spring Boot APIs; role-based access and multi-tenancy.
- **FinTech and payments**: payment rails, wallets, ledgers and reconciliation, engineered for correctness and auditability. Stripe, PayPal and wallet integrations; idempotent webhooks and retries; PCI-DSS and SOC 2 readiness.
- **Cloud and DevOps**: AWS (EC2, RDS, ECS) and Docker; CI/CD, staging and one-click rollback; monitoring, alerting and disaster recovery.
- **Platform rescue and modernization**: performance and security audits, legacy to modern stack migrations, and takeovers from previous vendors, without customer downtime.

## Engagement models

- **Discovery and Architecture Sprint** (1 to 2 weeks, fixed fee): codebase and infrastructure audit, architecture and data model, fixed-price build proposal.
- **Fixed-Scope Build** (6 to 16 weeks, fixed price): web, mobile and admin dashboards; payments, auth and integrations; launch, monitoring and 90-day support.
- **Dedicated Engineering Team** (monthly, ongoing): full-stack, cloud and QA engineers working in the client's tools, rituals and repos; scale up or down monthly.

## Process

1. Discovery call: 30 minutes with a co-founder, free.
2. Architecture sprint: audit, system design, fixed scope, timeline and price in writing (week 1 to 2).
3. Build in sprints: weekly working demos on staging (week 3+).
4. Launch and scale: zero-downtime release, monitoring, runbooks and ongoing support.

Commitments: kickoff in 14 days; fixed price agreed upfront; the client owns all code, infrastructure and documentation from day one; weekly working demos.

## Selected work

- **OnlyPark** (PropTech, Australia): rebuilt a Laravel admin into a Next.js + NestJS platform on AWS for permits, enforcement and car-park operations. 80% faster page loads; contract extended.
- **The Pip Collective** (FinTech, trading education): stabilized auth and rebuilt Stripe payment flows on a live, paying platform after the previous team left. 99% payment success rate restored.
- **Dawlati** (job platform, UAE): bilingual English/Arabic job portal with a NestJS backend for matching, applications and employer profiles. 100k+ listings and applications supported.
- **AskInProperties** (real estate, UAE): Next.js real-estate portal with property search, filters, project galleries and lead capture.

Other clients include Scopeology, Autoversal and Core for Contractors. 5.0 star client rating on Upwork; 8+ platforms in production.

## FAQ

- **How much does a project cost?** It depends on scope, platforms and integrations. An exact fixed price is given after the architecture sprint, before build work starts. A free 60-second cost estimator is on https://glintvex.com/.
- **How fast can Glintvex start?** Typically within 14 days of agreeing scope.
- **Can Glintvex take over an existing codebase?** Yes. Audit first, stabilize auth, payments and performance, then improve or rebuild only where it pays off.
- **Who owns the code and IP?** The client, from day one.
- **Does Glintvex work with in-house teams?** Yes, either leading delivery end to end or embedded in the client's team.
